home.privacyDesc: All data is processed locally in your browser. Nothing is sent to any server.
home.fastDesc: No loading, no waiting. Tools work instantly with zero latency.
home.freeDesc: No signup, no limits, no hidden fees. Free forever.
home.responsiveDesc: Fully responsive. Use on desktop, tablet, or mobile.

json-formatter.name: JSON Formatter
json-formatter.description: Format, validate, and beautify JSON data with syntax highlighting
json-formatter.pageDescription: Format, beautify, minify, and validate JSON data online. Supports syntax checking and custom indentation.
json-formatter.seoContent: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight data-interchange format. This JSON formatter tool helps you format, beautify, minify, and validate JSON data. Simply paste your JSON, click Format, and get a clean, readable output. Perfect for debugging API responses, config files, and data processing.
json-formatter.seoFeature1: Format & beautify JSON with custom indentation (2, 4, or 8 spaces)
json-formatter.seoFeature3: Validate JSON syntax with detailed error messages
json-formatter.seoFeature4: 100% client-side processing — your data never leaves your browser

base64.name: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
base64.description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text
base64.pageDescription: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings back to plain text. Supports UTF-8.
base64.seoContent: Base64 is a binary-to-text encoding scheme that represents binary data in an ASCII string format. It's commonly used for encoding data in URLs, emails, HTML, and APIs. This tool supports full UTF-8 encoding and decoding.

url-encoder.name: URL Encoder/Decoder
url-encoder.description: Encode or decode URL components and query parameters
url-encoder.pageDescription: Encode or decode URLs and URI components. Supports encodeURIComponent and encodeURI.
url-encoder.seoContent: URL encoding replaces unsafe ASCII characters with a "%" followed by two hexadecimal digits. This is essential for passing special characters in URLs, query parameters, and form data. Use encodeURIComponent for query parameters and encodeURI for full URLs.

hash-generator.name: Hash Generator
hash-generator.description: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes from text
hash-generator.pageDescription: Generate SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 hashes from any text. All computed in your browser.
hash-generator.seoContent: Cryptographic hash functions generate a fixed-size hash value from input data. They're used for data integrity verification, password storage, digital signatures, and more. SHA-256 is the most commonly used algorithm today.

uuid-generator.name: UUID Generator
uuid-generator.description: Generate random UUIDs (v4) in bulk with one click
uuid-generator.pageDescription: Generate random UUIDs (v4) in bulk. Supports uppercase, no-dash formats.
uuid-generator.emptyState: Click "Generate UUIDs" to create random UUIDs
uuid-generator.seoContent: UUID (Universally Unique Identifier) v4 generates random 128-bit identifiers. With 122 random bits, the probability of a collision is astronomically low. UUIDs are commonly used as database primary keys, session tokens, and distributed system identifiers.

timestamp-converter.name: Unix Timestamp Converter
timestamp-converter.description: Convert between Unix timestamps and human-readable dates
timestamp-converter.pageDescription: Convert Unix timestamps to readable dates and vice versa. Auto-detects seconds and milliseconds.
timestamp-converter.seoContent: A Unix timestamp represents the number of seconds since January 1, 1970 (UTC). It's widely used in programming, databases, and APIs. This tool auto-detects whether the input is in seconds or milliseconds.

color-converter.name: Color Converter
color-converter.description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL formats with preview
color-converter.pageDescription: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, and HSL formats with live preview.
color-converter.emptyState: Enter a color value and click Convert
color-converter.seoContent: HEX colors use hexadecimal notation (#RRGGBB). RGB uses red, green, and blue channels (0-255). HSL uses hue (0-360°), saturation (0-100%), and lightness (0-100%). Each format has its use cases in web design, CSS, and graphic design.

regex-tester.name: Regex Tester
regex-tester.description: Test regular expressions with real-time matching and highlighting
regex-tester.pageDescription: Test regular expressions with real-time matching, highlighting, and capture group support.
regex-tester.seoContent: Regular expressions (regex) are powerful patterns used for matching, searching, and replacing text. They're essential for input validation, text processing, and data extraction. This tool tests your regex in real-time with JavaScript's regex engine.

markdown-preview.name: Markdown Preview
markdown-preview.description: Write Markdown and see the rendered preview side by side
markdown-preview.pageDescription: Write Markdown and preview the rendered HTML in real time. Side-by-side editor and preview.
markdown-preview.seoContent: Markdown is a lightweight markup language created by John Gruber. It's widely used for README files, documentation, blogs, and notes. This preview tool renders your Markdown in real-time without sending data to any server.

jwt-decoder.name: JWT Decoder
jwt-decoder.description: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens (header, payload, signature)
jwt-decoder.pageDescription: Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens. View the header, payload, and signature.
jwt-decoder.placeholder: Paste your JWT token here (e.g. eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...)
jwt-decoder.invalidFormat: Invalid JWT format: expected 3 parts separated by dots
jwt-decoder.seoContent: JWT (JSON Web Token) is a compact, URL-safe token format used for authentication and information exchange. A JWT consists of three parts: Header (algorithm & type), Payload (claims & data), and Signature (verification). JWTs are commonly used in OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and API authentication.

qrcode-generator.name: QR Code Generator
qrcode-generator.description: Generate QR codes from text, URLs, or any data
qrcode-generator.pageDescription: Generate QR codes from text, URLs, or any data. Download as PNG image.
qrcode-generator.placeholder: Enter text, URL, or any data...
qrcode-generator.seoContent: QR (Quick Response) codes are two-dimensional barcodes that can store URLs, text, contact info, and more. They can be scanned by any smartphone camera. This tool generates QR codes with error correction for reliable scanning.

lorem-ipsum.name: Lorem Ipsum Generator
lorem-ipsum.description: Generate placeholder text in paragraphs, sentences, or words
lorem-ipsum.pageDescription: Generate placeholder text in paragraphs, sentences, or words for design and development.
lorem-ipsum.seoContent: Lorem Ipsum is dummy text used in the printing and typesetting industry since the 1500s. Designers and developers use it as placeholder text when actual content isn't available yet. It helps visualize layouts without distracting readers with meaningful content.

html-entity.name: HTML Entity Encoder
html-entity.description: Encode and decode HTML entities and special characters
html-entity.pageDescription: Encode special characters to HTML entities or decode entities back to characters.
html-entity.seoContent: HTML entities are special codes used to display reserved characters in HTML. Characters like <, >, &, and \" must be encoded to prevent them from being interpreted as HTML markup. This is crucial for preventing XSS attacks and displaying code snippets.

css-minifier.name: CSS Minifier / Beautifier
css-minifier.description: Minify or beautify CSS code for production or readability
css-minifier.pageDescription: Minify CSS for production or beautify it for readability. Removes comments and extra whitespace.
css-minifier.seoContent: CSS minification removes unnecessary characters like whitespace, comments, and semicolons to reduce file size. Smaller CSS files load faster, improving website performance and user experience. Use beautify mode to make minified CSS readable again.

number-base.name: Number Base Converter
number-base.description: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal
number-base.pageDescription: Convert numbers between decimal, binary, octal, and hexadecimal instantly.
number-base.helperText: Type a number in any field and the other bases will be calculated automatically.
number-base.seoContent: Different number base systems are used in computing: Binary (base 2) for machine-level operations, Octal (base 8) for Unix permissions, Decimal (base 10) for everyday use, and Hexadecimal (base 16) for memory addresses, colors, and compact binary representation.

text-diff.name: Text Diff Checker
text-diff.description: Compare two texts and highlight the differences
text-diff.pageDescription: Compare two texts side by side and highlight the differences between them.
text-diff.seoContent: Text diff compares two versions of text and highlights the differences. It's essential for code review, document comparison, and tracking changes. Green lines indicate additions, red lines indicate removals.

word-counter.name: Word Counter
word-counter.description: Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs in text
word-counter.pageDescription: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and estimate reading time.
word-counter.placeholder: Start typing or paste your text here to see word count, character count, and more...
word-counter.seoContent: This word counter tool provides detailed text statistics including word count, character count (with and without spaces), sentence count, paragraph count, and estimated reading time. Perfect for writers, students, and content creators who need to meet word count requirements.

password-generator.name: Password Generator
password-generator.description: Generate secure random passwords with customizable options
password-generator.pageDescription: Generate strong, random passwords with customizable length and character types.
password-generator.emptyState: Click "Generate Passwords" to create secure passwords
password-generator.seoContent: Strong passwords should be at least 12 characters long and include a mix of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. This generator uses cryptographically secure random number generation (crypto.getRandomValues) for maximum security.

sql-formatter.name: SQL Formatter
sql-formatter.description: Format and beautify SQL queries for better readability
sql-formatter.pageDescription: Format and beautify SQL queries for better readability. Supports common SQL dialects.
sql-formatter.seoContent: Well-formatted SQL queries are easier to read, debug, and maintain. This tool automatically adds indentation, capitalizes keywords, and places clauses on separate lines. Supports SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and JOIN statements.

cron-parser.name: Cron Expression Parser
cron-parser.description: Parse and explain cron expressions with next run times
cron-parser.pageDescription: Parse cron expressions to human-readable descriptions with next scheduled run times.
cron-parser.seoContent: Cron is a time-based job scheduler in Unix-like systems. A cron expression consists of 5 fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, and day of week. Special characters include * (any), / (step), , (list), and - (range). Used extensively in CI/CD, scheduled tasks, and automation.
